evals.name: add-list-endpoint
evals.prompt: I need a way to see what's actually stored in the ad database without pulling down megabytes of base64. Add a GET /ase/predef/list endpoint that returns every stored ad's id and description — no images. Show me the code.
evals.expected_output: A new Resource in aig/src/server/apis/predefinedads.py using the established Flask-RESTX pattern: a new api.model for the lightweight response, @api.route on the existing namespace, @api.marshal_list_with, @api.response decorators, and retrieval through the AseServerMetadata ChromaDB helpers rather than a raw client.
assertions: Adds the endpoint in aig/src/server/apis/predefinedads.py on the existing namespace rather than creating a new module or registering a new namespace
Uses the Flask-RESTX pattern established in the file: api.model for the response schema plus @api.route and @api.marshal_list_with / @api.response decorators
Retrieves data through the AseServerMetadata singleton / chromadb_* helpers rather than instantiating a ChromaDB client directly
Correctly reflects that the namespace is mounted at /ase so @api.route('/predef/list') yields /ase/predef/list
Excludes the base64 image field from the response schema, satisfying the stated purpose

evals.name: configurable-ad-cooldown
evals.prompt: Ads for the same product come round again way too fast when only a couple of items are in frame. I want a configurable cooldown — once we've shown an ad for a product, don't show that product again for N seconds. Make N settable without rebuilding. Where does this go and what's the change?
evals.expected_output: A change in web-ui/main.py's Ad_Generator selection path (find_product_for_ad_generation / find_rotating_candidate), tracking a per-product last-shown timestamp, driven by a new env var added in all three places: .env, docker-compose.yml web-ui environment block, and os.getenv in code with a matching default.
assertions: Locates the change in web-ui/main.py within the Ad_Generator product-selection path (find_product_for_ad_generation or find_rotating_candidate)
Adds the new environment variable in all three required places: .env, the web-ui environment block in docker-compose.yml, and os.getenv in the code
Uses an os.getenv default matching the value placed in .env
Handles the case where the cooldown would exclude every candidate, rather than allowing selection to return nothing indefinitely
Notes that web-ui is baked into its image so the change needs make build (not just a container restart), unlike aig/src which is bind-mounted

evals.name: reenable-price-overlay
evals.prompt: Something's off with /aig/minf/ — I send price_details and the API accepts it, but the price never shows up on the generated image. Meanwhile the same field works fine through the predefined-ad path. Figure out why and fix it.
evals.expected_output: Identifies that the price-drawing block is commented out in aig/src/server/apis/modelinf.py while predefinedads.py applies it, then re-enables it in the correct position in the price -> promo -> frame -> logo -> slogan chain, keeping the img_postprice variable threading intact.
assertions: Identifies that the price block is commented out in aig/src/server/apis/modelinf.py as the root cause
Notes the asymmetry that predefinedads.py does apply the price overlay, explaining the reported difference between the two paths
Places the re-enabled price drawing before promo in the overlay chain and keeps the image variable threading (img_postprice feeding into the promo step) consistent
Uses the existing ImgDecorator methods (draw_price_circle / draw_price_raw) and respects the price_in_circle flag rather than writing new drawing code
Mentions that aig/src is bind-mounted so the change can be verified with docker restart aig-server rather than a full rebuild
